ValidationRule.description: Leaving Draft requires the core request details.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Intake Complete"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Documents Pending"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Underwriting"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Credit Review"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Conditionally Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Closing"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Booked")), OR(ISBLANK(Primary_Contact__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Purpose__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Loan_Type__c)), ISBLANK(Term_Months__c), ISBLANK(Relationship_Manager__c), ISBLANK(Submission_Date__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before leaving Draft, enter the Primary Contact, Purpose, Loan Type, Term Months, Relationship Manager, and Submission Date.
